<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F8FCFF"/>
  
  <!-- status bar -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="30" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="20" y="20" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
    <line x1="322" y1="18" x2="322" y2="12" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="327" y1="18" x2="327" y2="10" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="332" y1="18" x2="332" y2="8" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="347" cy="14" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="347" y1="14" x2="352" y2="9" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="362" y="8" width="22" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="364" y="10" width="16" height="8" rx="2" fill="#00A47D"/>
    <rect x="384" y="12" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
  </g>

  <!-- header -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="30" width="390" height="58" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <polyline points="28,60 20,68 28,76" fill="none" stroke="#4B4B4C" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="195" y="66" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="20" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">Trip lessons</text>
    <circle cx="356" cy="59" r="4" fill="#FFC800"/>
    <circle cx="356" cy="72" r="4" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
  </g>

  <!-- progress -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="101" width="350" height="12" rx="64" fill="#E5E5E5"/>
    <rect x="20" y="101" width="117" height="12" rx="64" fill="#00A47D"/>
    <text x="20" y="133" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="13" font-weight="900" fill="#6F6F70">STEP 1 OF 3</text>
    <text x="370" y="133" text-anchor="end" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#00A47D">GET STARTED</text>
  </g>

  <!-- title -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="178" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="26" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Where are you going?</text>
    <text x="20" y="207" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">Tell us about your trip and we’ll make</text>
    <text x="20" y="229" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">lessons that fit your plans.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- destination field -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="267" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">DESTINATION</text>
    <rect x="18" y="279" width="354" height="58" rx="13" fill="#D9D9D9" opacity="0.35"/>
    <rect x="20" y="277" width="350" height="58" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="44" cy="305" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="51" y1="312" x2="57" y2="318" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="69" y="311" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="17" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">e.g. Paris, France</text>
    <text x="20" y="356" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">You can change this later.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- language card -->
  <g>
    <rect x="18" y="377" width="354" height="105" rx="14" fill="#D9D9D9" opacity="0.4"/>
    <rect x="20" y="375" width="350" height="105" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E5E5" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="38" y="404" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">LANGUAGE FOR YOUR TRIP</text>
    <rect x="39" y="418" width="62" height="42" rx="11" fill="#FF4B4B"/>
    <rect x="39" y="418" width="21" height="42" rx="11" fill="#1899D6"/>
    <rect x="60" y="418" width="20" height="42" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="80" y="418" width="21" height="42" rx="0" fill="#FF4B4B"/>
    <text x="116" y="443" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="20" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">French</text>
    <text x="116" y="462" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">Travel vocabulary</text>
    <circle cx="343" cy="438" r="13" fill="#00A47D"/>
    <polyline points="337,438 341,442 349,433" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- activities section -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="518" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="21" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">What will you do there?</text>
    <text x="20" y="543" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">Choose all that sound like your trip.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- activity cards -->
  <g>
    <rect x="18" y="558" width="354" height="48" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E5E5" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="43" cy="582" r="13" fill="#D1EBF7"/>
    <circle cx="43" cy="579" r="4" fill="#1899D6"/>
    <ellipse cx="43" cy="588" rx="8" ry="4" fill="#1899D6"/>
    <text x="68" y="588" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Meet new people</text>
    <rect x="338" y="571" width="22" height="22" rx="5" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#9DAD88" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="18" y="614" width="354" height="48" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E5E5" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="43" cy="638" r="13" fill="#FFEF8F"/>
    <circle cx="43" cy="638" r="7" fill="#FFC800"/>
    <line x1="43" y1="625" x2="43" y2="622" stroke="#FFC800" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="43" y1="651" x2="43" y2="654" stroke="#FFC800" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="68" y="644" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Explore local food</text>
    <rect x="338" y="627" width="22" height="22" rx="5" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#9DAD88" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="18" y="670" width="354" height="48" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E5E5" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="43" cy="694" r="13" fill="#DDF4FF"/>
    <polygon points="43,684 52,700 34,700" fill="#1899D6"/>
    <circle cx="43" cy="691" r="3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="68" y="700" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">See famous places</text>
    <rect x="338" y="683" width="22" height="22" rx="5" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#9DAD88" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>

  <!-- disabled continue button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="738" width="350" height="48" rx="13" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
    <text x="195" y="768" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">Continue</text>
  </g>

  <!-- bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="795" width="390" height="49" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="16" y1="795" x2="374" y2="795" stroke="#E5E5E5" stroke-width="1"/>
    <g>
      <polygon points="39,811 49,803 59,811 59,824 39,824" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
      <polyline points="35,812 49,800 63,812" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="49" y="840" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">Home</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="127" cy="812" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="127" y1="803" x2="127" y2="821" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="118" y1="812" x2="136" y2="812" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="127" y="840" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">Practice</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <rect x="187" y="802" width="36" height="27" rx="8" fill="#DDF4FF" stroke="#63C9F9" stroke-width="2"/>
      <polygon points="195,812 202,806 209,812 209,821 195,821" fill="none" stroke="#1899D6" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <text x="205" y="840" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#1899D6">Trips</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="294" cy="809" r="5" fill="#6F6F70"/>
      <ellipse cx="294" cy="821" rx="11" ry="5" fill="#6F6F70"/>
      <text x="294" y="840" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">Profile</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="353" cy="811" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
      <circle cx="353" cy="811" r="3" fill="#6F6F70"/>
      <line x1="353" y1="797" x2="353" y2="801" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="353" y1="821" x2="353" y2="825" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="353" y="840" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">More</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
